name: ftksaas
description: FtkSaaS backend and frontend migration-ready workspace

scripts.generate: python3 scripts/generate-runtime.py && node scripts/generate-validators.mjs && node scripts/build-edge.mjs && node scripts/generate.mjs && python3 scripts/render_catalogs.py
scripts.verify: python3 scripts/check-migrations.py && python3 scripts/generate-runtime.py --check && node scripts/generate-validators.mjs --check && node scripts/build-edge.mjs --check && node scripts/generate.mjs --check && python3 scripts/render_catalogs.py --check && node scripts/audit.mjs && node scripts/governance.mjs && tsc --noEmit && node --test tests/contract.test.mjs tests/governance.test.mjs && node --test tests/ci-policy.test.mjs && pnpm run verify:workspace
scripts.test: pnpm run verify && pnpm run test:db && pnpm run test:api
scripts.db:advisors: supabase db advisors --local --type all --level warn --fail-on error
scripts.test:api: node --test --test-concurrency=2 tests/cross-center-settlement.test.mjs tests/api-acceptance.test.mjs tests/event-payment.test.mjs tests/event-cancellation.test.mjs tests/registry.test.mjs tests/person-registry.test.mjs tests/room-role-registry.test.mjs tests/availability-policies.test.mjs tests/schedule-reads.test.mjs tests/program-session-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/starter-attendance-protection.test.mjs tests/instructor-earnings.test.mjs tests/p01-catalog-entitlement-reads.test.mjs tests/p01-lesson-requests.test.mjs tests/p01-waitlist-workers.test.mjs
